assign.request: Research how we build our own AI harness on OpenRouter (or the providers directly), through the Research system. Owner's words: owner-words.md in this folder. Budget about $15.
steps: Open the task and the Research topic, split into 7 sub-areas
Round 1: one Opus + one Sonnet minion research in parallel, fenced
Round 2: a fresh Opus judges each claim (true, logic, useful)
Verdicts, summary, preliminary plan with build order and cost
Research page shows the structure: tree, counts, verdicts, detail on click
Review by mastermind-servex-3, fold in its answer

decision.question: How to fence the two round-1 scouts
options: Opus on the external/provider questions, Sonnet on the repo-facing ones
decision.chose: Opus: OpenRouter vs direct, agent package vs own, fleets. Sonnet: harness parts, sandboxing, Servex SDK replacement, switcher
decision.why: The provider comparisons need the most judgement from web sources; the repo-facing areas are mostly reading Servex/ and the widget code.

log.msg: Credence has no field on topic nodes; scouts write it as a 'credence: …' prefix in --why. Gap noted for ext/Research.

decision.question: The Research page leads with 7 huge summary paragraphs (shot of /framework/research/livereload/ at 1920). How to show structure?
options: a separate hand-made report page for this topic
fix ext/Research's Research page so every topic shows the tree first
decision.chose: fix ext/Research in worktree qf-2, one Sonnet minion
decision.why: The owner wants this on any card at any time; a one-off page would leave every other topic as paragraphs.

assign.now: waiting on three minions (two scouts, the page minion); each wakes the task mastermind when it ends

log.msg: sonnet scout done: 28 claim/question/alternative nodes across q2iwg, q267z, qqtqi, qg9ju. Most surprising: no code anywhere enforces a minion's file fence -- it is prose-only in the minion skill, nothing technical stops a write outside the brief.

agent.outcome: 28 nodes under q2iwg, q267z, qqtqi, qg9ju — $1.64

log.msg: Round 1 landed: 50 nodes, $2.79. Both scouts converge independently: don't replace the Agent SDK, add OpenRouter as a second backend (Opus: via ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL; Sonnet: via the unused tiers.js provider field).

assign.now: round 2: fresh Opus judging every claim (true / logic / useful)

agent.outcome: 48 supported, 3 disputed (cihlr, cllhf, am32f), 2 added (opencode arm ah7hc, canUseTool fence ceq98) — $1.13

log.msg: Verdicts written on all 7 sub-areas and 22 key nodes; 7-line summary set. plan.md folds in round 2.
Gap for ext/Research: topic nodes have no credence field and no separate true/logic/useful judgements; both ride as prefixes in why.
Servex refused a message to mastermind-servex-3 (a task mastermind may message only mastermind-servex, its parent and children); review sent to mastermind-servex instead.

assign.now: review by mastermind-servex; page minion still building

log.msg: Architect review (mastermind-servex-3) folded into plan.md: spike as a real Servex agent with its own env and no Claude login; OpenRouter usage.cost from run one; PreToolUse fence (bypassPermissions skips canUseTool); cross-review is review.mjs --model; new order 1, 2, review, fence, picker.

assign.now: waiting on the page minion (worktree qf-2) — the last deliverable before landing

decision.question: How to name a topic-tree grid item when the root's text has no early '?' or ':' (a claim root, or a question whose '?' lands at the very end of a long sentence)
options: cut at the first '?'/':' wherever it falls, even near the end of a long sentence
cut at '?'/':' only when it's early, else fall back to a word-count cap
always cap by word count and ignore '?'/':' entirely
decision.chose: cut at '?'/':' when present, THEN cap the result by word count either way
decision.why: a trailing '?' on a long sentence (the Servex-SDK-replacement question) was passing through whole; capping after the cut fixes both the short 'OpenRouter or direct?' case and the long one with one rule.

decision.question: Where '{true,logic,useful}:' judgements and 'credence: X' live in the schema (verbs.js has no such fields)
options: ask the mastermind to add fields to verbs.js first
read them as prefixes/markers inside the existing free-text `why` field, per the writers' own convention (this task's log line 30 names this exact gap)
decision.chose: parse them out of `why` client-side; no schema change
decision.why: verbs.js is outside this fence, the writers already use the prefix convention, and this page is read-only — no reason to block a rendering rule on a schema change.

log.msg: Research.js/css rewritten: topic tree (icon grid, ranked, capped 9) above the fold; compact verdict tally + summary as a short list at normal size; click routes to #<id>, opens that sub-area's existing card tree, scrolls on load, survives reload/back; minion strip collapsed to one muted line, moved below; credence tag + true/logic/useful three-line body added, parsed from `why`. Verified: node --check, Server/smoke.mjs (0 console errors on both topics), Playwright screenshots at 1920 incl. a direct #qnjkd reload.

agent.outcome: Research.js/css restructured to tree-first: grid of root items, compact verdicts, click-to-detail routed by hash, credence tag, judged support/dissent body. Screenshots + smoke pass in ai/2026-09-28/harness-research/shots/.

assign.title: AI harness: research, verdicts and a build plan
assign.outcome:
**Don't build a harness first: run the Claude Agent SDK through OpenRouter with a non-Claude model, as a real Servex agent, and try opencode beside it.**

![](/framework/ai/2026-09-28/harness-research/shots/harness-live-1920.png)

- [x] research through the Research system: [/framework/research/harness/](/framework/research/harness/), 7 sub-areas, 111 nodes
- [x] one Opus and one Sonnet, then a fresh Opus: 50 claims, then 48 backed, 3 disputed, 2 added (true / logic / useful in each `why`)
- [x] structure, not paragraphs: the sub-areas are a grid with claim counts and verdicts; a click opens the detail, and each has its own URL (`#qqtqi`)
- [x] a preliminary plan with build order and cost: [plan.md](/framework/ai/2026-09-28/harness-research/plan.md), 6 steps, the first is the proxy spike
- [x] reviewed by the Servex architect: [architect-review.md](/framework/ai/2026-09-28/harness-research/architect-review.md), folded in

Spend: about $11 of $15 (minions $7.73).

Left: no walkthrough page (the page is itself the show-first view; budget); the count under a sub-area includes support and dissent nodes, not only claims; topic nodes have no credence field, so it rides in `why`.

agent.outcome: Research.js/css: tree grid first, verdict tally, summary list, hash-routed detail — $3.81 (over its $2 budget); merged via merge.mjs
